# mcp-ecc — Email, Calendar & Contacts MCP Server

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that aggregates **email, calendar and contacts** from Google (Gmail/Calendar/People), Microsoft 365 & Outlook (Microsoft Graph), Zoho, IMAP/SMTP, CalDAV and CardDAV. Multi-user server: each user self-manages their own provider accounts and uses their own per-user MCP API key on the `/mcp` Streamable HTTP endpoint.

## Quick start

- Clone: `git clone https://github.com/karljsamuel/mcp-ecc.git && cd mcp-ecc && npm install && npm run build`
- Run the CLI (stdio): `node packages/cli/dist/bin.js start`
- Run the single-container server (web UI + REST + MCP on port 3001): `docker compose up -d`
- MCP endpoint: `http://<host>:3001/mcp` over Streamable HTTP, authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <user MCP API key>`
